Name: Yume Nikki Furniture
Author: MatiMay
Description:
[size=3]This simple mod adds furniture and decorations from the Japanese indie game "Yume Nikki" to your Stardew Valley.
Currently, it includes:
- Madotsuki's beloved Nazca rug (6x4 & 3x4)
- Poniko's rug, as well as Uboa event variation. (6x5)
- Poniko's posters, closet and window.
- 4 different pieces of mural (5x6 & 2x2)

More coming in the future.
[color=#444444]I do hope your house doesn't include a balcony.[/color]
The sprite is mainly from the game Yume Nikki. Which I made changes on so they fit Stardew Valley.
The mod is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url] by Platonymous[/size]. [size=3]Thanks the author for making the work so simple.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Added Poniko's posters, poniko's window (actually paintings) and poniko's closet. Each can be switched to the Uboa event variation through right clicking. The 3x2 window cannot be implemented as a window due to the weird lighting it would cause.
